lines.say: This is C C voice gateway, a small prototype.
lines.caption: This is cc-voice-gateway, a small prototype.

lines.say: You talk to Claude, and Claude Code does the work.
In the Claude app, voice mode talks with you.
But it can't reach Claude Code on your computer.
The gateway connects the two of them.
Voice mode calls it as a custom connector.
It hands each request to a Claude Code session on your computer, and brings the answer back.
You can ask why a build failed.
Ask for a fix, and a worker makes the change and runs the tests.
It commits on a branch and opens a pull request.
Then you hear the result in a sentence or two.
The changes stay in git, as pull requests to review at your desk.
Answers are short, and there is nothing to read.
And if you say emergency stop, everything locks.
It is meant for time away from the desk, like a commute, with your eyes on the road.
C C voice gateway is a prototype, provided as is. The code is on GitHub.
